thesis: The episode introduces Danny Meyer, founder of Union Square Hospitality Group and chairman of ShakeShack, who discusses how great hospitality leads to great business across various sectors. The conversation explores Meyer's philosophy that hospitality is the starting point for his business, emphasizing the importance of first impressions and his concept of 'ABCD' (always be connecting dots).
